occurrences.checkable_against: Independent fish and water contamination testing near Unity State oil fields

occurrences.subject: South Sudan Unity State oil pollution and flooding

occurrences.checkable_against: Rift Valley Institute field observations and epidemiological studies of Unity State pollution
occurrences.quote_span: "Many animals are dying because of this pollution, and people are also suffering from symptoms they attribute to it. All of this is visible, but we do not yet have sufficient evidence or epidemiological studies to state it with certainty," explains researcher Marko Gatkuoth, who is attached to the Rift Valley Institute — an independent research organization operating primarily in Central and Eastern Africa.

occurrences.subject: South Sudan Unity State oil pollution and flooding
